In the profile, multiple rock layers can be seen in an upper-lower superposed state, with the upper rock layers covering the lower rock layers. The legend shows sedimentary layers such as aquicludes and aquifers. The figure does not show a situation in which the rock layers as a whole are overturned. Reasoning: The question asks about the depositional sequence of the “upper” and “lower” rock layers. According to the law of stratigraphic superposition, in normally superposed sedimentary rock layers, the rock layers in lower positions form first, and the rock layers in higher positions are deposited later and cover them. Therefore, the lower rock layers were deposited first, and the upper rock layers were deposited later.

method.method_draft: 观察剖面中岩层的上下位置，确认题目问的是“上部”和“下部”岩层的沉积先后。由于图中岩层为正常叠置的沉积层，上部覆盖下部，按地层层序律可判断下部岩层先沉积，上部岩层后沉积。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是等温线及地质剖面示意图，剖面中可以看到多层岩层呈上下叠置状态，上部岩层覆盖在下部岩层之上，图例显示有隔水层和含水层等沉积层。图中没有显示岩层整体倒转的情况。推理：题目问“上部”和“下部”岩层的沉积先后。根据地层层序律，在正常叠置的沉积岩层中，位置较低的岩层先形成，位置较高的岩层后沉积并覆盖其上。因此，下部岩层先沉积，上部岩层后沉积。
method.model_answer: 下部先沉积，上部后沉积
